thesisQuality.basis: 45.1 GW contracted backlog through 2030 plus differentiated domestic thin-film manufacturing support durable demand/value capture.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 sales $1.06B, gross profit $605M, net income $423M and $1.7B net cash; sales declined 4% YoY but earnings improved.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Sep. 22 market cap about $21.6B and trailing P/E about 12.4x against strong earnings/backlog provide attractive but policy-sensitive headroom.

catalystScore.basis: Backlog conversion, South Carolina capacity and reaffirmed 2026 guidance are identifiable execution catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Guidance discipline and capital deployment are visible, though this evidence set is not a full proxy-governance review.

alignment2036.basis: Utility-scale solar manufacturing directly serves long-duration electricity and grid capacity needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Geographic manufacturing and utility customers diversify execution somewhat, but core economics remain concentrated in solar modules.

bottleneckControl.basis: Domestic differentiated module capacity and delivery certainty are valuable constraints, but competing solar technologies remain available.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Large backlog and cash support resilience, offset by policy, permitting, financing and termination exposure.

substitutionResilience.basis: Thin-film differentiation and domestic footprint create barriers while crystalline-silicon alternatives remain credible.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Domestic manufacturing footprint and ongoing capacity investment improve resilience, with policy/input dependencies still material.

pricingPower.basis: Gross profit of $605M on $1.06B Q2 sales demonstrates strong economics, though contract adjustments/terminations constrain certainty.

riskEvidence.basis: Termination, policy and project-economics risks are real, but liquidity and backlog reduce near-term execution risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC filing/exhibit plus independent valuation data cover operating, balance-sheet, backlog and market inputs.
